entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-24
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [Blazor] DisplayName/Label: ExpressionMemberAccessor caches every accessor expression instance (memory leak on Blazor Server) #70031
  • [API Proposal] Capture pending JSRuntime calls for deferred failure #70030
  • RedisOutputCacheStore force reconnect can release the current connection instead of the failed one #70029

PullRequests

Created

  • Publish IIS server addresses before registering request callbacks #70036
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Don't expire infinite Kestrel timeouts on the next heartbeat #70035
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Reject chunk sizes larger than Int32.MaxValue with 400 #70034
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Reject HTTP/1.1 request lines with no space before the version #70033
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Fix native review setup and worker lifecycle #70032
  • Cancel pending cookie renewal when the principal is rejected #70028
    area-auth, community-contribution

Updated

  • Do not emit or traverse non-security-enabled groups in Negotiate LDAP claims #69955
    area-auth
  • Set record constructor mapping flag after publishing the mappings #69909
    area-mvc, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • Give NavigationException a message that includes the target URI #69910
    area-blazor, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #69981
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • Skip ignored hub messages instead of stalling the SignalR connection #69397
    area-signalr, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • Canonicalize IDN host names in Kestrel SNI configuration #69395
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-networking
  • Fix ApacheModRewrite tokenizer throwing on regex shorthand escapes #68788
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-middleware
  • Fail pending server JS interop calls when circuits disconnect #68714
    area-blazor, untriaged, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #69983
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
